svg.text: Broken glass: where a released piece goes (CPU reference of the shard particle kernel, src/game/shardModel.ts)
one piece shot out of a pane 1.35 m up; the round travels to the right (+z). gravity 9.8, drag 0.5/s at 10 mm (∝ 1/size, ≤ 6), floor restitution 0.4 ± 40%, keep 0.78, sleeps under 0.3 m/s
SIDE VIEW — flights (a sample of each class), dots where they come to rest
TOP VIEW — the litter: every fragment at rest (1 m grid, dot size ∝ fragment size)

Computed, not rendered: the same equations, constants and emit draws as particles.wgsl (constants compared by name in probes.ts shards-model).
Per-touch dice are keyed differently, so this is the distribution, not any one GPU fragment. Nothing here was seen on a GPU.
